21.2.3 Alias template make_integer_sequence [intseq.make]
🔗
template<class T, T N>
  using make_integer_sequence = integer_sequence<T, see below>;
1
#
Mandates: N  ≥ 0.
2
#
The alias template
make_integer_sequence denotes a specialization of
integer_sequence with N constant template arguments.
 The type make_integer_sequence<T, N> is an alias for the type
integer_sequence<T, 0, 1, …, N - 1>.
 [Note 1: make_integer_sequence<int, 0> is an alias for the type
integer_sequence<int>.
 — end note]
